description.value: Kypriaki Mediterranean Grill is a Greek-Cypriot restaurant on Marine Drive in North Vancouver, named after the island of Cyprus and featuring a statue of Aphrodite at its entrance. Voted one of the 'Best Five Greek Restaurants' in the Lower Mainland by The Province newspaper, it serves made-from-scratch Mediterranean dishes including souvlaki, moussaka, and saganaki. The restaurant offers both a full indoor dining room seating up to 110 and a patio seating up to 40, plus a casual lounge area with large-screen TVs.

address.value: 106-1346 Marine Drive, District of North Vancouver

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the business name, address (#106-1346 Marine Drive, North Vancouver), and phone (604-985-7955). The menu explicitly lists vegetarian, GF-marked, and halal items, and the site prominently advertises dine-in, takeout, and delivery. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water bottle refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
